name: Bandtastic multi-band BB oversold + RSI/MFI
author: Robert Roman (per __author__)
indicators: RSI, MFI, Bollinger(20, stds 1,2,3,4) on typical price, EMA fast/slow (hyperopt)
entry_long: RSI<buy_rsi AND MFI<buy_mfi AND EMA_fast>EMA_slow AND close<BB lower (selected band(s) per params, optionally 1/2/3/4 std)
exit: close>BB upper band (selected by sell params) AND RSI>sell_rsi (see source)
implementation_notes: Params hyperopted (parameter values live in class attributes); author attribution to verify in file header. Freqtrade note: minimal_roi/stoploss are part of the published strategy; ROI exits are time-since-entry based. Source file is the sole spec; no independent verification of results.
